verdict.rationale: An official SDK or programmatic API is a fair question for a package-manager tool, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only CLI commands (install, add, audit, pm, publish), and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Community praise for Bun's shell scripting API, SQLite and S3 client concerns runtime features, not an official SDK for the package manager, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
